limits: This is an offline consumer workload over an authorized real DEX, not BIL runtime integration or a product performance result.
Events cover only selected metadata-reader reads during snapshot-open on the caller thread, not all DEX/query or hardware accesses.
Replay uses a synthetic single-thread lifetime; it does not reproduce the original cross-thread release or failure lifecycle.
The direct variants have no Memory domain; clearing local references does not prove OS reclamation.
File hashes, child-reported module paths and process outputs do not constitute signed provenance or mapped-byte attestation.
The persistent-byte budget excludes filesystem metadata and temporary files created by child processes.
Input, input hash, trace bytes, command output and local paths remain private.
